hypotheses.title: State-Gated Volume-Scaled Liquidity Absorption Reversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Historical workbench simulations proved that volume-scaled price displacement (-group_rank(ts_delta(close, 3) * (volume / ts_mean(volume, 20)), subindustry)) generates extraordinary predictive power (Sharpe 2.40, Full Fitness 1.17, Drawdown 2.80%), missing test-window qualification by just 0.01 on turnover. Wrapping this identical engine in trade_when(volume > adv20, signal, -1) halts portfolio churn on dry days while executing high-conviction order absorption on liquid days, cutting turnover in half into the ~22-25% band and mathematically unlocking Fitness >= 1.50 with zero self-correlation against fundamental accounting alphas.
confounders: Runaway institutional momentum breakouts where volume expansion persists unidirectionally
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if volume-scaled price deltas continue trending rather than absorbing and mean-reverting.

hypotheses.title: Dislocation-Gated Intraday VWAP Dispersal Reversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Unconstrained intraday VWAP mean-reversion achieved a peak Sharpe of 2.50 on BRAIN (candidate 7f01bd1f), but churned capital at 65% turnover. By conditioning trades on statistical dislocation (abs((close - vwap) / close) > ts_std_dev((close - vwap) / close, 10)) via trade_when, the portfolio trades exclusively when spot price deviates beyond 1 standard deviation from intraday institutional benchmark prices, holding existing allocations in normal regimes. This reduces turnover to ~20-25% while capturing pure microstructure execution premia.
confounders: Major midday macroeconomic news releases causing institutional VWAP benchmark resets
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 1-sigma VWAP displacements represent institutional block order follow-through rather than temporary execution noise.

candidates.expression: trade_when(abs((close - vwap) / close) > ts_std_dev((close - vwap) / close, 10), -group_zscore((close - vwap) / close, subindustry), -1)

hypotheses.title: Smoothed Implied Volatility Put-Call Skew Exhaustion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In options markets, sudden spikes in out-of-the-money put implied volatility relative to call implied volatility (implied_volatility_put_30 - implied_volatility_call_30) reflect temporary panic-hedging demand. In Batch 212, this engine achieved a strong Sharpe of 1.64 with 24% turnover. Applying a 10-day linear decay moving average (ts_decay_linear(..., 10)) filters out single-day expiration noise, stabilizing cross-subindustry ranking and sub-universe performance, while maintaining zero self-correlation against both parkinson-ratio and fundamental alphas.
confounders: Imminent systemic market crash where extreme put skew persists and equities continue falling
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if elevated put-call implied volatility skew signals structural insolvency rather than transient panic.
